text: Performance doctrine frozen in ADR 008 with machine-readable Tier-1 and receipt contracts. The court now requires semantic admission, minimized comparator-defect handling, public end-to-end and prepared-topology boundaries, separate cold/warm receipts, exact/tolerance checksums, immutable pinned sources, quiescent-host proof, raw clustered samples, and row-level classification. Tier-1 has 10 families/20 expanded rows. Win requires median ratio <=0.90 and 99% CI upper <=0.95; ties do not pass. Material memory loss is >10% and >64 MiB; capacity/scaling constraints remain independent gates. Validation: both JSON documents parse, Draft 2020-12 meta-schema accepts receipt.schema.json, row/comparator/kernel/corpus references are internally consistent, and git diff --check is clean.
